items.summaryZh: 1980年F1世界冠军艾伦·琼斯逝世，澳大利亚人，对国内外赛车运动有着深远的影响。

media.altZh: 1980年F1世界冠军艾伦·琼斯逝世 · 第 1 张

items.originalTitle: We are saddened to hear the news that 1980 F1 World Champion Alan Jones has passed away. A proud Australian and an inspiration to those in his home co...
items.summaryEn:
We are saddened to hear the news that 1980 F1 World Champion Alan Jones has passed away. 
A proud Australian and an inspiration to those in his home country and around the world, Alan's mark on the sport will be remembered forever. 
Our thoughts are with his family and friends at this sad time. Rest in peace, Alan. 🧡
detailZh:
我们听到1980年F1世界冠军艾伦·琼斯去世的消息感到非常悲痛。
艾伦是一位自豪的澳大利亚人，也是他家乡和全世界人们的灵感来源，艾伦在赛车运动上的印记将永远被记住。
在这个悲伤的时刻，我们与他的家人和朋友同在。艾伦，愿你在天堂安息。🧡
detailEn:
We are saddened to hear the news that 1980 F1 World Champion Alan Jones has passed away. 
A proud Australian and an inspiration to those in his home country and around the world, Alan's mark on the sport will be remembered forever. 
Our thoughts are with his family and friends at this sad time. Rest in peace, Alan. 🧡

items.titleZh: Lance因墨西哥感染病毒缺席媒体日，恢复良好预计周五回归
items.summaryZh: Lance因感染病毒缺席媒体日，恢复情况良好，预计周五回归。
items.originalTitle: Lance will miss media day today as he continues to recover from a viral infection contracted in Mexico. He is recovering well, and we are confident he...
items.summaryEn:
Lance will miss media day today as he continues to recover from a viral infection contracted in Mexico. He is recovering well, and we are confident he will return to the paddock on Friday.
#BrazilGP
detailZh:
Lance今天将缺席媒体日，因为他正在从在墨西哥感染的一种病毒中恢复。他的恢复情况良好，我们相信他将在周五回到维修区。
#巴西大奖赛
detailEn:
Lance will miss media day today as he continues to recover from a viral infection contracted in Mexico. He is recovering well, and we are confident he will return to the paddock on Friday.
#BrazilGP
